## MechaHydra (2×)

- Size: Huge
- Models: 1x MechaHydra
- Type: Mechanical, Walking, Drone
- Armor: 9/8/8/7
- Points: 144
- Shaken: still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

- **Repair**: [1, self, 2nd Healing]
- **Heads**: 1 major head, 6 minor head. Keep track of number of functional minor heads at any time, Poison spits, laser eyes and assault is dependent on the number of functional heads.
- **Forward Position**: [1]
- **Resistance**: Fire[1]

**Damage Table: Regular**

| Roll | Effect |
| ---- | ------ |
| 1-3 | +1 to future damage |
| 4-5 | +2 to future damage |
| 6-17 | +2 to future damage, destroy one minor head. If all minor heads are destroyed, add additional +3 to future damage instead. Set unit on fire |
| 18 | Unit destroyed |


### MechaHydra

- Equipment: 1x Shrapnel Spit, 1x Poison Spit, 1x Laser Eyes
- Assault: strength 6/6/6/6 (5+), deflection 6/2/2/2 (5+), damage d6, AP 2


- **Boost**: +3 assault strength  and +1 assault deflection per alive head
- **Assault Extra Damage**: Poison[6][1 for 2]
- **Cunning Assault Defense**: [3, 5+]

#### Shrapnel Spit

- Range: 3, angle True/True/False/False, damage d4-2, AP 1
- **Area**: [1+]. at point blank; [4+]. at normal blank

#### Poison Spit

- Range: 2, angle True/True/False/False, damage -, AP N/A
- **Range Extra Damage**: Poison[8]
- **Multiple Shots**: Fire one time per functional minor head

#### Laser Eyes

- Range: 3, angle True/True/False/False, damage d4-3, AP 1
- **Critical**: unit is set on fire.
- **Multiple Shots**: Fire two time per functional head (minor and major)
